message.content:
Below is a quick‑look at the **federal Canadian holidays that create long weekends in 2023**.  
(If you’re planning for a specific province, let me know and I can add the provincial holidays that also create long weekends.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-------------------|
| Family Day | Feb 20 (Mon) | Feb 18–20 (Fri–Mon) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Fri) | Apr 7–9 (Fri–Sun) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Mon) | May 20–22 (Fri–Mon) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Mon) | Sep 2–4 (Fri–Mon) |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Mon) | Oct 7–9 (Fri–Mon) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Mon) | Dec 23–25 (Fri–Mon) |

### Quick notes

* **New Year’s Day** (Jan 1, Sunday) and **Canada Day** (Jul 1, Saturday) fall on weekends, so they don’t create an extra day off unless your province observes them on a Monday.
* **Remembrance Day** (Nov 11, Saturday) also falls on a weekend.
* Some provinces observe additional holidays that create long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.). If you need those, just let me know the province(s).

Feel free to copy the table into your holiday‑planning app or let me know if you’d like the data in a different format (JSON, CSV, etc.).
